description: Queries raw busy intervals for one or more calendars or groups over an exact time range. Returns per-calendar and per-group availability and errors, without event titles or details. Use googlecalendar.find_free_slots when you want default time bounds and computed free intervals; use googlecalendar.events_list when you need event records.

calendarExpansionMax.description: Maximal number of calendars for which FreeBusy information is to be provided. Optional. Maximum value is 50.
calendarExpansionMax.human_parameter_description: The maximum number of calendars to include in the free/busy results. Set this to cap results if you are querying many calendars.
calendarExpansionMax.title: Calendar Expansion Max

groupExpansionMax.description: Maximal number of calendar identifiers to be provided for a single group. Optional. An error is returned for a group with more members than this value. Maximum value is 100.
groupExpansionMax.human_parameter_description: The maximum number of people to expand when a group is included. Use this to limit very large groups so the request stays manageable.
groupExpansionMax.title: Group Expansion Max

items.description: List of calendars and/or groups to query. Accepts either strings (e.g., ['primary', 'user@example.com']) or objects with an 'id' field (e.g., [{'id': 'primary'}]). String values are automatically converted to the proper format. Only calendars with at least freeBusyReader-level access are queried; omitting shared/secondary calendars can hide real conflicts. Batch all attendees into one call to avoid 403 rateLimitExceeded or 429 tooManyRequests errors.
items.human_parameter_description: The calendars and/or groups you want to check for availability. Provide the calendar or group IDs (often email addresses) you want included. You can use simple strings like 'primary' or 'user@example.com'.

id.description: The identifier of a calendar or a group.
id.title: Id

items.title: Items

timeMax.description: The end of the interval for the query formatted as per RFC3339. Exclusive bound; must be greater than timeMin. Keep the timeMin–timeMax window within ~90 days; larger spans may return empty or degraded results.
timeMax.human_parameter_description: The end of the time window to check calendar availability. Choose the date and time when you want the availability search to stop.
timeMax.title: Time Max

timeMin.description: The start of the interval for the query formatted as per RFC3339. Must be strictly less than timeMax. For full-day windows, use local 00:00 in the target timezone to avoid DST/off-by-one errors.
timeMin.human_parameter_description: The start of the time window to check calendar availability. Pick the date and time when you want the availability search to begin.
timeMin.title: Time Min

timeZone.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is UTC. Defaults to UTC, which skews working-hours analysis for users in other timezones; always supply a valid IANA timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York').
timeZone.human_parameter_description: The time zone to interpret your start and end times and display results. Leave empty if you want to use UTC.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

name: free_busy_query

end.description: End of the busy period, in RFC3339 timestamp format.
end.title: End

start.description: Start of the busy period, in RFC3339 timestamp format.
start.title: Start

busy.description: List of time ranges during which this calendar should be regarded as busy.
busy.title: Busy

errors.description: Optional error(s) (if computation for the calendar failed).
errors.title: Errors

reason.description: The specific reason for the error (e.g., 'notFound').
reason.title: Reason

calendars.description: List of free/busy information for calendars.
calendars.title: Calendars

display_url.description: URL to view this resource in the Google Calendar web UI. None for free/busy queries as they have no dedicated UI view.
display_url.title: Display Url

kind.description: Type of the resource. Always the fixed string 'calendar#freeBusy'.
kind.title: Kind

timeMax.description: The end of the interval covered by the response, in RFC3339 timestamp format.
timeMax.title: Time Max

timeMin.description: The start of the interval covered by the response, in RFC3339 timestamp format.
timeMin.title: Time Min

calendars.description: List of calendars' identifiers within a group.
calendars.title: Calendars

errors.description: Optional error(s) (if computation for the group failed).
errors.title: Errors
